title: HOPE preserves expert connections when pruning MoE models
teaser: Researchers have introduced HOPE, a method for reducing the number of experts in mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models. It accounts not only for the importance of each expert individually, but also for its connections to other experts. Across three models and five benchmarks, HOPE achieved the best average rank among five pruning methods. When removing 50% of the experts, it had an average rank of 1.58, compared with 2.42 for its closest competitor, REAP. On Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with half its experts removed, HOPE scored 42.3 on SWE-Bench Pro, slightly above the unpruned model’s 41.8.
